property.name: Collecting performance statistics
property.description: Turning on this option enables collection various statistics at runtime for the adapter

property.name: 4.x style tracing log messages
property.description: Turning on this option enables 4.x style and disables 5.x style tracing of log messages

property.name: Option to add custom microagent methods to standard microagent
property.description: Turning on this option will add file adapter specfic microagent agent methods to standard microagent

property.name: Option to enable debug log to display or not
property.description: Turning on this option will enable debug log to display for issue investigation at runtime for the adapter

property.name: Option to enable log4J
property.description: Turning on this option will enable log4j to trace runtime then generate more detail log

property.name: Specify log4j property file
property.description: Specify log4j property file for log4j

property.name: Enable tracing thread id
property.description: If ON, the thread ID is traced in the Log4J log

property.name: Enable sending BusinessEvents messages
property.description: Turning on this option will enable sending BusinessEvents messages

property.name: JMS Map Message support for SFT mode
property.description: Enable or disable JMS MapMessage support for SFT mode

property.name: Log progress every X messages (Publication Services Only)
property.description: If set to 10, the adapter will print a progress status every 10 messages

property.name: Send LotEnd indicator with last data message (Publication Services Only)
property.description: Turning on this option will send the LotEnd indicator with the last data message when the data format is MBusinessDocument. Otherwise a separate message will be sent

property.name: Write unmatched records to XML or Text file (Publication Service Only)
property.description: When set to "XML" unmatched records will be written to an XML file. When set to "Text" unmatched records will be written to a plain text file

property.name: Check field count and record length when validating a record. (Publication Services Only)
property.description: Check field count and record length when validating a record

property.name: Treat quoted fields as one field (Publication Services Only)
property.description: Treat quoted fields as one field when set to "ON". Default: "OFF"

property.name: Compress JMS messages (Publication Service Only)
property.description: When set to "ON" publication services will set JMS property "JMS_TIBCO_COMPRESS" to "true" and messages will get compressed before sent to the EMS server

property.name: Flush data if no new data appended to input file after N polls (Publication Services Only)
property.description: Flush the data in memory if no new data appended to the input file after N polling. Default: 3

property.name: Turn on/off load balancing. (Publication Services Only)
property.description: Turn on/off load balancing. Default: OFF

property.name: Treat null Number field as zero. (Publication Services Only)
property.description: Treat null Number field as zero. Default: OFF

property.name: Publish empty fields. (Publication Services Only)
property.description: Publish empty fields. Default: OFF

property.name: Set grouping factor for BusinessDocuments. (Publication Services Only)
property.description: Set grouping factor for BusinessDocuments. This overrides the adapter configuration in Advanced/Grouping Factor

property.name: Enable Multi-thread to publish Big File. (Publication Services record mode Only)
property.description: Turning on this option will enable Multi-thread to publish Big File

property.name: Set the thread count for Multi-thread. (Publication Services record mode Only)
property.description: Set thread count for Multi-thread to publish the file. Default:1, Max:99, Min:1

property.name: Start subscriber only on a new file upon restart (Subscription Service Only)
property.description: When set to "ON" Start subscriber only on a new file upon restart. Default: ON

property.name: Reverse order of child records (Subscription Service Only)
property.description: When set to "ON" subscription services will reverse the order of child records

property.name: Do not add EOF to the final record of a file (Subscription Service Only)
property.description: When set to "ON" do not add EOF to the final record of a file. Default: OFF

property.name: Prevent writing duplicate messages (Subscription Service Only)
property.description: If true, this property prevents a subscription service from writing duplicate messages, which are caused by a publication service restart, to the output file. This property only applies to Business Document data format

property.name: Skip the empty record (Subscription Service Only)
property.description: If true, subscription service will skip the empty record

property.name: Use file name embedded in incoming BusinessDocument message (Subscription Service Only)
property.description: If true, this property instructs the subscription service to use the filename embedded in the LotId attribute in the incoming message when creating the output file instead of using the filename specified in TIBCO Designer. This property only applies to the Business Document data format

property.name: prevents a subscription service from continuing working, but exit when running io issues(Subscription Service Only)
property.description: If true, this property prevents a subscription service from continuing working, but exit when running io issues

property.name: prevents a subscription service from flush msg everytime(Subscription Service Only)
property.description: If true, subscription service will flush msg to disk everytime

property.name: timestamp appended to the file in the output directory will be 12hr format
property.description: If true, subscription service will append 24hr format timestamp to the file in the output directory

property.name: file will be moved from WIP to output directory when the subscriber is stopped
property.description: If true, file remains in the WIP directory when subscriber is stopped
